objects.name: Analytic 1751
objects.description: For Android, detect Keylogging by correlating analyst-visible device/network evidence and management state; use streaming or batched telemetry only where the documented collector is deployed. Correlate API Calls via Application Vetting / Instrumented Dynamic Analysis [Dynamic API/runtime trace: AccessibilityEvent.TYPE_VIEW_TEXT_CHANGED received by listener NOT IN $AccessibilityAllowList$ at rate > $KeystrokeEventThreshold$ per minute with source_apps spanning > $AppMonitorCountThreshold$ distinct apps]; Network Traffic Content via Enterprise Secure Web Gateway / Proxy [DNS/HTTP(S) inspection or proxy transaction metadata where enterprise decryption/inspection is deployed]; Permissions Request via Android Enterprise DPC / Application Vetting [DevicePolicyManager.getPermissionGrantState(); PackageManager manifest/requested-permission review]. Alert on a sequence or state change inconsistent with the device/app baseline, approved management policy, or expected user workflow; do not infer unobserved API calls, file/process activity, or payload content from management state alone.
